summary: Custom and edited catalog records discard nozzle/bed temperatures, source revision, and per-field provenance during local database persistence.
claim: Custom and edited catalog records discard nozzle/bed temperatures, source revision, and per-field provenance during local database persistence.

evidence.source: In app/src/main/kotlin/net/jamesjennison/spoolio/data/Databases.kt, the CustomRecord Room entity defines only id, brand, material, product, colorName, colorHex, diameterMm, massG, and updatedAt columns. In MainViewModel.kt, saveCustom() persists a CustomRecord and converts it back via asCatalogEntry(), which hardcodes all nozzle and bed temperature fields to null.

suggested_remediation: Extend the CustomRecord database entity schema to store nozzleMinC, nozzleMaxC, bedMinC, bedMaxC, sourceRevision, and provenance metadata. Update CustomDialog and MainViewModel.saveCustom() to collect, validate, and persist temperature ranges and provenance.
suggested_validation: Create a custom record with nozzle temperatures (230-250 °C) and bed temperatures (80-90 °C). Kill the application process, reopen the app, and verify that the saved custom record retains all temperature values and provenance metadata.
